hooks.logic:
Let part be part 2 of the enemy.
Let part2 be part 1 of the enemy.
Let hpRate be the HP fraction of part.
If part is judged dead and part is alive and part2 is judged dead and part2 is alive, then choose state 23 next and stop.
If part is judged dead and part is alive, then choose state 22 next and stop.
If part2 is judged dead and part2 is alive, then choose state 21 next and stop.
If hpRate is at most the numeric entry "hp_rate_to_phase_2" in the battle settings of the enemy, then
  Let paramIdBySuffixNo be the stat block of form "4" on part.
  If the value "paramId" of part is not paramIdBySuffixNo, then
    Let paramIdBySuffixNo2 be the stat block of form "4" on part.
    Part changes to stat block paramIdBySuffixNo2.
    Part cancels its cast and stop.
If part is dead and part2 is alive, then
  Let paramIdBySuffixNo3 be the stat block of form "2" on part2.
  If the value "paramId" of part2 is not paramIdBySuffixNo3, then
    Let paramIdBySuffixNo4 be the stat block of form "2" on part2.
    Part2 changes to stat block paramIdBySuffixNo4.
    Part2 cancels its cast.
    Set the register's 'doubleAttackRate' to the numeric entry "rate_to_double_attack_dead_omniscient" in the battle settings of the enemy and stop.
If condition flag "countup_turn" is up this frame and util passes a fraction roll of the register's 'doubleAttackRate', then part2 uses (a smart-weighted move of part2) immediately.
_ → each with (list, given (x) { Let part3 be part x of the enemy. If part3 is ready to act, then part3 picks and uses a smart-weighted move. }, this state).

  Let self be the acting enemy.
  If not every item in list passes given (x) { Let part be part x of self. Return part is judged dead or part is dead and not (part has the DISABLE status). }, then change state to 13.
